description: Says you added credits at Quo, as the 'I added credits' control on Settings > Data Sources does, clearing the 'Quo is refusing to send texts' alert. Quo has no balance check, so this settles the refusal until Sergio's next text; a later refused text raises the alert again. Nothing is sent. Pass the same idempotency_key when retrying. An owner-level change: Sergio tells the owner after it is made.

idempotency_key.description: Your id for this operation (8-128 of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -). Reuse it on every retry of the same operation; use a new one for a new operation.

reason.description: Why you are doing this, in one sentence. The owner sees it in the notice Sergio sends after the change.

name: confirm_quo_credits_added
title: Mark Quo credits added
